description: S51 T2 (TM5), the backlog seen whole — and a READ that writes nothing (TestBoardCandidatesAreReadOnly): the suggest path stores an embedding because asking computes one; the board of a whole backlog stores NOTHING. Each row carries the bug (validation and priority as TWO fields, D2), the two rendered sentences (validation: … and priority: … — unvalidated and could-not-tell read DIFFERENT sentences, never one merged badge), the attempt digest from the audit rows (attempts counts the validate rows; lastAttemptAt names the newest), the duplicate candidates WITH their distances (a suggestion with its nearness — smaller is nearer — never a link; only a human confirmation links, D5), and the roadmap item's CURRENT status when the bug was handed off (D8). Every filter word is one of the closed sets — triage.vocabulary answers which; a word outside them (including the hidden brainstorm, a setting word and never a bug state) is refused by name.

bug.title: retry counter over-counts on the third attempt
bug.body: the counter adds the attempt number, not one
